answer_1.quote: We propose P 3 SUM, a diffusion model that steers the political stance of the generation towards the news article at inference time with an off-the-shelf classifier.

answer_2.quote: For summarization utility evaluation, we employ Rouge-1/2/L scores ) and abstractiveness scores .

answer_4.quote: To complement the manually selected model summaries and the original labels in the POLITICS dataset, we conduct an additional human evaluation to measure the stance preservation and factuality.
answer_4.guideline: 150 news articles (50 each for left, center, and right) and their generated summaries are selected from the POLITICS dataset and manually evaluated.
